entities.name: TECPR1
observations: The 768-aa query matches reviewed Gallus gallus TECPR1 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; human TECPR1 Q7Z6L1 matches at 72.1% identity and 100% query coverage.

Reviewed human TECPR1 annotations support phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding and a tethering role in autophagosome maturation/fusion with lysosomes; autophagy and selective antibacterial autophagy are implicated.
Annotated localization includes autophagosome membrane, early endosome membrane, lysosomal membrane, and autolysosome-related membranes.
Pfam hits include Pex24p (PF06398), Tectonin (PF19193), and repeated Hyd_WA (PF06462) regions; domain hits support repeat-rich architecture but do not alone establish mechanism.
The sequence-based functional assignment is homology-supported. Chicken reference function/localization are marked by similarity; human reference includes experimentally supported GO annotations.
